t: Frogtape Pro Grade Decking & Joist Tape provides essential waterproof protection for timber structures. This durable flashing tape is ideal for covering deck joists, stair stringers, posts, and ledger boards, safeguarding them from moisture damage. Its UV and weather-resistant properties ensure long-lasting performance in various outdoor conditions. The tape is odourless and solvent-free, offering a safer application experience. Featuring a self-healing capability around nails and screws, it maintains a continuous waterproof seal. An initially repositionable acrylic adhesive allows for precise placement, while its all-weather performance surpasses typical butyl tapes, ensuring reliable timber protection and saving installation time with its self-wound design.
